title: Passage to the limit in a Sobolev bound along C¹ approximations with uniformly bounded, a.e. convergent derivatives supported in a fixed compact set
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (c : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0) (S : Set (Rn N)) (u : Rn N → ℝ) (v : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ), IsCompact S → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (v j)) → (∀ j, tsupport (v j) ⊆ S) → (∀ j y, ‖fderiv ℝ (v j) y‖ ≤ K) → (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn N)), Tendsto (fun j ↦ v j y) atTop (𝓝 (u y))) → (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn N)), Tendsto (fun j ↦ fderiv ℝ (v j) y) atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ u y))) → (∀ j, eLpNorm (v j) p volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ∫ y, ‖fderiv ℝ (v j) y‖)) → eLpNorm u p volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ∫ y, ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖)
